description: Algolia CLI: index deletion, clearing, and overwrites, record deletion, API keys, and read commands.

rules.note: `indices delete` and `indices clear` remove an index or all its records. `indices move` and `indices copy` overwrite the destination index. `objects delete`, `rules delete`, `synonyms delete`, and `apikeys delete` remove data or keys.
`apikeys list` and `apikeys get` print key values. `apikeys create` makes a new key and prints it.

safe.note: Index lists, searches, settings, and browses of records, rules, and synonyms only read.
